result:
If I could actually do it, I'd make people *much* harder to manipulate.

Not smarter in the narrow IQ sense, not more "educated," just dramatically less susceptible to bullshit — their own and everyone else's. Most of the world's worst problems aren't caused by lack of resources or even lack of intelligence. They're caused by people being incredibly easy to lie to, including by themselves. If that vulnerability got cut in half, a lot of the rest would start sorting itself out.
